contract.comparison_rule: case-folded, punctuation-stripped, whitespace-collapsed substring of the instruction
contract.detection_is_not_diagnosis: a flag records that the bank failed on a wrong tree, not that it failed for the requirement that tree breaks
contract.exclusion_unit: the whole test function, because that is what pytest reports
contract.grounding_source: spec.txt only - the text the generator was already shown; the hidden verifier and the named requirements in the truth package are never consulted
contract.no_critic: no second model, no critic pass, no cross-model check
contract.question: does forcing each generated test to quote the requirement it tests reduce the rate at which banks reject correct code?
contract.single_change_from_gen58_gen60: the generator prompt requires a verbatim REQUIREMENT citation per test, and a mechanical filter removes tests whose citation is not in the visible instruction
contract.specificity_note: retained for continuity but non-discriminating - it is measured after the validity gate has already removed every bank that rejects a correct tree
unchanged: bank assembly by concatenation, no semantic filtering

inherited_sanitizer.detects_tests: top-level functions and methods inside test classes

frozen.session: one stateless HTTP request per repetition; no conversation carried over
